title: Login page exposes the intended main form
steps: Open the login URL; inspect the visible main form and links.
expected: One main login form; identifier/password and submit visible; reset and registration links visible.

title: Password is masked
steps: Inspect the visible password field type.
expected: Input type is password; input enabled.

title: Both required fields empty
steps: Load fixture; fill fields; click Login.
expected: Browser blocks submission; specified field has valueMissing=true, nonempty validationMessage and focus; login URL retained.

title: Identifier empty
steps: Load fixture; fill fields; click Login.
expected: Browser blocks submission; specified field has valueMissing=true, nonempty validationMessage and focus; login URL retained.

title: Password empty
steps: Load fixture; fill fields; click Login.
expected: Browser blocks submission; specified field has valueMissing=true, nonempty validationMessage and focus; login URL retained.

title: Email identifier entry
steps: Type fixture value into main identifier; read it back; do not submit.
expected: The typed value is preserved. This tests input handling, not authentication or account validity.

title: Special and Unicode password entry
steps: Type synthetic password fixture; read back; do not submit.
expected: Typed value preserved and field remains type=password. No length policy inferred.

title: Keyboard focus sequence
steps: Focus identifier; press Tab; press Tab again.
expected: Focus moves to main password and then main submit button.

title: Forgot password navigation
steps: Click the main form reset link; wait for destination.
expected: URL is https://mathx.vn/quen-mat-khau.html and destination has a visible input; do not submit reset.

title: Registration navigation
steps: Click the main form registration link; wait for destination.
expected: URL is https://mathx.vn/dang-ky.html and destination has a visible input; do not create an account.

title: Invalid credentials rejected by button
steps: Fill synthetic reserved-domain credentials; submit once using button.
expected: Login form remains visible and main region shows explicit invalid-credentials feedback. No successful authentication. Exact message is TBD; proposed rejection regex is documented.

title: Invalid credentials rejected by Enter
steps: Fill synthetic reserved-domain credentials; submit once using Enter.
expected: Login form remains visible and main region shows explicit invalid-credentials feedback. No successful authentication. Exact message is TBD; proposed rejection regex is documented.

title: Successful login using registered email

expected: Authenticated account identity and destination match approved expectations. TBD – Stakeholder confirmation required.
